item_short_desc: Delve into the depths of military expertise with Rothco’s Military Mountaineering TC 90-6-1 Manual. This training manual consists of over 130 pages of detailed illustrations that offer insights into a wide array of topics. With chapters covering basic mountaineering techniques, movement of individuals, unit movement and evacuation, and operations on glaciers and fixed alpine paths, the manual provides a comprehensive guide that is perfect for military personnel, survivalists, and outdoor enthusiasts.
description: Delve into the depths of military expertise with Rothco’s Military Mountaineering TC 90-6-1 Manual. This training manual consists of over 130 pages of detailed illustrations that offer insights into a wide array of topics. With chapters covering basic mountaineering techniques, movement of individuals, unit movement and evacuation, and operations on glaciers and fixed alpine paths, the manual provides a comprehensive guide that is perfect for military personnel, survivalists, and outdoor enthusiasts. Illustrated Pages: This field manual features over 130 pages filled with detailed illustrations to ensure easy comprehension and practical application of mountaineering skills. Timeless Wisdom: The military manual contains lessons and techniques that transcends decades, offering invaluable insights for both the field and emergency situations. Portable Size: The mountaineering instruction manual features compact 8.25 inch x 5.25 inch dimensions, ensuring it fits easily into your tactical gear or backpack for convenient on-the-go reference.
